units.title: Creating

topics.title: I can arrange and compose music

subtopics.title: I can notate simple rhythmic patterns using a defined selection of note values

outcomes.text: I can recognize long and short sounds and identify simple rhythms from notation.
I can write music rhythms or sounds, using symbols.
I can identify same and different rhythm patterns.

subtopics.title: I can notate simple melodic patterns using a defined selection of pitches

outcomes.text: I can create and recognize high and low sounds to represent some pitches.
I can write high and low notes on a music staff to represent pitches.
I can identify same and different melodic patterns.

subtopics.title: I can notate musical ideas using musical symbols to represent pitch and rhythm

outcomes.text: I can sing a variety of pitches and rhythms and label a music staff with clef and metric symbols.
I can write note and rest values on a music staff.
I can write beats and rhythms within measures.

subtopics.title: I can arrange a short song for my voice

outcomes.text: I can create a simple tune (monopho-nic melody) without accompaniment, within specified guidelines.
I can create a melody using rhythms that are appropriate for the time signature.
I can develop a melody using pitches that are appropriate for the tonality.

subtopics.title: I can arrange a short song for two voices, using harmony

outcomes.text: I can develop a simple tune with accompanying parts (homopho-nic work).
I can develop an original arrange-ment of a traditional canon or round.
I can develop my song using I, IV, and V chord pro-gressions.

subtopics.title: I can arrange a short song for an ensemble, demonstrating an understanding of voicing and texture

outcomes.text: I can combine different voices to create various tone colors in my arrange-ment.
I can experiment with changes in tone color, creating variety and contrast through a combination of different voices.
I can experiment with non-chord tones and chord pro-gressions.

subtopics.title: I can describe how I use melody, rhythm, and harmony to compose or arrange a work for a specific purpose

outcomes.text: I can arrange melodic themes for specific purposes, using arrangement and composition-al techniques.
I can use composition-al techniques to compose works in a given musical form.
I can compose short compositions in major and minor keys.

subtopics.title: I can collaborate with others to compose or arrange a musical work for a specific purpose

outcomes.text: I can sing in ensembles, working with others to develop ideas as we compose or arrange a composition.
I can work with others to analyze arrange-ments and original compositions for improve-ments.
I can compose an original composition in Four-Part Chorale Style.

subtopics.title: I can compose short, original musical ideas and works using all the elements of music for a specific purpose

outcomes.text: I can create musical ideas and works using chord progressions and modulations.
I can use characteristic forms of music to create a choral composition for a specific purpose.
I can compose a choral composition with a variety of expressive devices.

subtopics.title: I can imitate a musical statement by sight and sound

outcomes.text: I can match sound and pattern.
I can imitate a given music rhythm or sound using symbols.

subtopics.title: I can answer a musical question

outcomes.text: I can identify simple forms.
I can identify same and different patterns.

subtopics.title: I can arrange a musical idea

outcomes.text: I can use rhythm patterns, songs or words to create a musical idea.
I can create a musical idea given specific instructions.

subtopics.title: I can combine musical ideas to create phrases for voice, instruments, or body movement

outcomes.text: I can explain the use of ostinato to arrange a melodic idea.
I can construct arrange-ments of simple pieces for voices or instruments.

subtopics.title: I can compose a rhythmic and melodic phrase

outcomes.text: I can organize rhythmic and melodic patterns into a musical phrase.
I can create a melodic phrase over a given rhythmic idea.

subtopics.title: I can add harmony to compose or arrange phrases for a given mood

outcomes.text: I can identify key signatures in melodic phrases.
I can construct a rhythmic, melodic and harmonic idea for a given mood.

subtopics.title: I can arrange, compose, and explain intent using melody, rhythm, and harmony

outcomes.text: I can use the circle of fifths to explain transposition of a written musical work.
I can use and explain compositional techniques to compose works in a music form.

subtopics.title: I can collaborate with others to compose or arrange a variety of musical styles

outcomes.text: I can revise a composition based on the feedback from others to improve composed works.
I can work with others to compose an original composition.

subtopics.title: I can compose music within expanded forms

outcomes.text: I can create an original composition independent-ly.
can create a new arrangement from a given composition.

topics.title: I can use movement exploration to discover and create artistic ideas and works
